//: TEMPLATE for the PRIVATE receipts ledger (schema gg-receipts-v2). Copy it to gravel-god-training-plans/db/receipts.json, delete the example entry, and add real athletes there. Never commit real athletes to gravel-race-automation (a public repo). Keys starting with // are notes; the loader ignores them. Validator: wordpress/receipts_data.py. How-to: docs/receipts-ledger-howto.md.
//synthetic: DELETE this line in the real ledger. true marks a fake ledger; GG_BUILD=production refuses it.
//coached_count: Every athlete coached since coached_since, including those who said no or never answered. Shown as: 'N athletes coached since 2023-10; those who chose not to be named appear only in this count'. Must be >= the number of entries below.
//coached_count_as_of: YYYY-MM-DD the count was last checked. Printed next to the count.

receipts.//id: PUBLIC: this id is printed in the page HTML (data-receipt-id). Use an opaque slug such as r-0007, never the athlete's name or initials. Stable, never reused. Anchors and media filenames are hashed from it.
receipts.//identity_tier: From the consent form: full_name | first_last_initial | first_age_group | count_only. count_only is counted and never rendered.
receipts.//display_name: Exactly the name the tier allows, checked by the build: full_name 'Firstname Lastname' (two or more words), first_last_initial 'Firstname L.', first_age_group 'Firstname' (one word; the age group is added on the page).
receipts.//age_group: U25, 35-39 or 60+ style. Must sit inside one grid band: Under 30 / 30s / 40s / 50+.
receipts.//ability: first_timer | enthusiast | competitive_amateur | elite. Places the athlete in the age x ability grid.
receipts.//tags: Allow-list only (wordpress/receipts_data.py TAGS): time_crunched_parent, masters, gravel_ultra, road_racer, multi_year, mtb, cyclocross, bikepacking, triathlete, first_gravel_race. Tags are exported to social/email tools.
receipts.//hours_per_week: Typical training hours, or null. Shown as 'N hrs/week'.
receipts.//coached_since: YYYY-MM this athlete started. Shown as 'Coached since February 2024'.

results.//event: Race name as the organiser writes it.
results.//field: Finishers in that ranking, integer, or null. Shown as '5 of 120'.
results.//official_url: REQUIRED, https. The official results page. The link is the proof; no link, no result.

receipts.//results: Only results the athlete consented to and that a stranger can check.
receipts.quote: Example quote text. Replace with the athlete's exact approved words.
receipts.//quote: The athlete's exact words, as approved. Empty string for none. Never edited after approval.
receipts.//quote_approved_at: YYYY-MM-DD the athlete approved this exact quote in writing. Required when quote is non-empty.
receipts.//render_approved_at: YYYY-MM-DD the athlete approved how their card/story renders. Nothing renders without it.

material_connection.//kind: none | comped | friend | colleague | business_partner | other.
material_connection.//display: Shown inline when kind isn't none, e.g. 'Coached at no charge', 'Friend and training partner of the coach', 'Colleague of the coach at TrainingPeaks'.

receipts.//material_connection: Any relationship besides paying client, disclosed inline (spec principle 4).
receipts.//channels: Where this athlete may appear, from the consent form: gravelgod | roadie | social | email | tp. A page or export for any other channel leaves them out.
receipts.//consent_id: The consent form response id. Private: validated, never rendered or exported.
receipts.//consent_expires: YYYY-MM-DD, 3 years from consent. After this date the entry stops rendering.
receipts.//withdrawn_at: YYYY-MM-DD when the athlete withdraws, else null. Set it, rebuild, push (spec section 8).
receipts.//source_ref: Private pointer to the evidence (email id, TP comment URL, form row). Never rendered, never exported.

story.text:
Example story paragraph one.

Example story paragraph two.
story.//text: Exact approved text. Blank line between paragraphs.
story.//voice: athlete = the athlete's own words (rendered as a quote) | editorial = text Matti wrote and the athlete approved (rendered as prose, not a quote).
story.//text_approved_at: YYYY-MM-DD the athlete approved this exact text.

receipts.//exchanges: TrainingPeaks post-activity comment threads between Matti and the athlete, as screenshots. Optional; [] for none. Each one needs its own approval.

exchanges.//image: Path relative to this ledger file: a screenshot of the TrainingPeaks post-activity comment panel only. Crop out metrics (HR, weight, power numbers), other people, and any name the identity tier doesn't allow. PNG, JPEG or WebP.
exchanges.alt: Coach: Example coach comment. Example R.: Example athlete reply.
exchanges.//alt: REQUIRED verbatim transcript of every comment in the screenshot, in order, 'Speaker: words'. Used as the image alt text (screen readers, search).
exchanges.//date: YYYY-MM-DD of the workout. Caption shows month and year.
exchanges.//theme: Free label for curation, not rendered.
exchanges.//rank: Integer; lower shows first in the carousel.
exchanges.//render_approved_at: YYYY-MM-DD the athlete approved this exact screenshot being published.
exchanges.//redaction_checked_at: REQUIRED. YYYY-MM-DD someone looked at the final cropped image and confirmed: no HR/weight/power or other metrics, no other people, no name beyond the identity tier. The build can't read pixels.
exchanges.//withdrawn_at: Optional. Set to withdraw just this screenshot.
exchanges.//consent_expires: Optional YYYY-MM-DD if this screenshot's consent ends before the athlete's.
exchanges.//channels: Channels for this screenshot; must also be in the athlete's channels.
